project.name: mmagent
project.description: XSkill multimodal tool-using agent runner for train/validation/test, experience memory, skill memory, and benchmark reporting.

nodes.name: Runtime Config
nodes.summary: Loads runtime.yaml and optional .env, validates mode/env values, writes paths/API/model settings into os.environ.

nodes.name: runtime.yaml
nodes.summary: Single experiment control file for mode, benchmarks, paths, API endpoints, retry limits, rollout counts, validation flags, and experience/skill settings.

nodes.name: main_flow.main
nodes.summary: Top-level train/val/test entry. Loads runtime config, builds shared context, then dispatches each benchmark to phase or staged validation.

nodes.name: MainFlowContext
nodes.summary: Resolves project-local benchmark, split, output, log, and prompt/tool defaults.

nodes.name: run_phase
nodes.summary: Builds one train/val/test phase: paths, memory root, execution args, environment patching, logging, inference, metrics, and health check.

nodes.name: ExperimentConfig
nodes.summary: Loads prompts, tool configs, data split, model name, sampling params, and experience batching rules for a phase.

nodes.name: RolloutRunner
nodes.summary: Schedules sample rollouts, supports parallel multi-rollout execution, resumes valid completed rollouts, discards transient failures, and triggers train-time memory updates.

nodes.name: MemoryRuntime
nodes.summary: Owns mutable memory prompt/retriever state during a phase and reloads memory after training updates.

nodes.name: memory retrieval and injection
nodes.summary: Builds sample query, retrieves direct experiences and modular skills, reranks memory, filters low-quality items, builds mandatory tool plan, injects skills/experiences into the system prompt, and logs memory usage.

nodes.name: API rollout processor
nodes.summary: Runs one multimodal agent rollout: loads images, calls model/tool loop, enforces required tool plan, synthesizes final answer when needed, evaluates, and saves rollout artifacts.

nodes.name: model/tool caller
nodes.summary: Creates model caller state and bridges tool/function-call responses to tool execution.

nodes.name: API caller
nodes.summary: OpenAI-compatible chat completion caller with bounded retries and transient failure handling.

nodes.name: tool registry and tools
nodes.summary: Callable agent tools including web_search, image_search, visit, zoom, and code_interpreter.

nodes.name: TrainingMemoryUpdater
nodes.summary: Collects completed training samples by large batch, snapshots memory, generates experience ops, merges the experience library, clusters skills, and reloads retriever/prompt state.

nodes.name: experience generation pipeline
nodes.summary: Summarizes rollouts, runs LLM critique, normalizes success/failure/recovery experience operations, auto-adds tool-backed success memories, and writes per-sample exp_items.json.

nodes.name: trajectory summary
nodes.summary: Converts multi-rollout trajectory JSONL plus optional image captions into compact evidence summaries for critique.

nodes.name: experience critique
nodes.summary: Prompts the LLM to extract intra-sample experiences and supervised recovery candidates from rollout summaries.

nodes.name: experience library
nodes.summary: Merges, deduplicates, prunes, and refines normalized experience records stored as experiences.json.

nodes.name: ExperienceRetriever
nodes.summary: Embeds experience content, caches embeddings, retrieves by similarity, optionally decomposes tasks and rewrites experiences for a sample.

nodes.name: experience schema
nodes.summary: Normalizes experience records and formats them for prompt injection.

nodes.name: skill generation
nodes.summary: Clusters normalized experiences by tags/content, builds action skills, recovery skills, and failure guardrails, preserves validation metadata, and writes skill markdown/index files.

nodes.name: skill retriever
nodes.summary: Retrieves modular skill candidates by embedding plus metadata filters and adds limited validation/recovery probe candidates when enabled.

nodes.name: skill-memory reranker
nodes.summary: Uses LLM reranking to choose final skills and linked/direct experiences for prompt injection.

nodes.name: tool plan
nodes.summary: Formats executable mandatory tool plans from selected skills and linked experiences.

nodes.name: staged validation
nodes.summary: Runs train stages from fixed split manifest, evaluates isolated validation memory snapshots, applies feedback/reflection, records history, and selects best memory.

nodes.name: validation feedback
nodes.summary: Applies validation metrics to experience/skill status, calibration, and best-memory selection.

nodes.name: validation reflection
nodes.summary: Optionally reflects on validation failures and writes recovery/correction experiences.

nodes.name: metrics
nodes.summary: Writes rollout results, sample summary, dataset pass@k/average@k, and diagnostic metrics.

nodes.name: validation reporting
nodes.summary: Aggregates validation history and writes analysis metrics/figures.

nodes.name: artifact utilities
nodes.summary: Central filenames and JSON/JSONL artifact helpers used across rollout, retrieval, metrics, and validation.

nodes.name: prompt templates
nodes.summary: System, experience generation, retrieval, skill generation, skill injection, judge, and recovery prompt templates.

LLM chooses final skill/experience set.

Writes retrieval_info.txt and memory_usage.json.

Creates the model caller and parses function-call responses.
Uses OpenAI-compatible chat completion for final synthesis and model calls.
Executes registered tools requested by the model.

tour.title: Start at runtime
tour.description: Read configs/runtime.yaml first, then configs/runtime.py. This explains which environment values every downstream module expects.

tour.title: Follow the dispatcher
tour.description: main_flow/main.py chooses direct phase execution or staged train-validation.

tour.title: Understand one phase
tour.description: main_flow/phase.py is the best mental anchor: it resolves paths, memory, args, logging, rollout execution, metrics, and health checks.

tour.title: Read rollout scheduling
tour.description: main_flow/rollout_runner.py explains skip/resume, valid-rollout retry, parallel scheduling, and when training samples are sent to memory generation.

tour.title: Read sample-level memory injection
tour.description: main_flow/memory.py shows how experience retrieval, skill retrieval, reranking, quality filtering, and mandatory tool plans become a dynamic system prompt.

tour.title: Read train-time memory construction
tour.description: experience/pipeline.py and main_flow/memory_update.py turn completed rollouts into normalized experiences and then into modular skills.

tour.title: Read staged validation last
tour.description: main_flow/validation.py explains why validation snapshots exist and how feedback selects the best memory.
